name: Hawaii Commercial Foods Inc
old_description: Located in Maui, Hawaii, Hawaii Commercial Food Inc. offers Authentic Korean food from Busan.
about:
Hawaii Commercial Foods Inc. was founded in 2016 in Kahului, on the island of Maui. The company traces its roots to a family kim chee recipe passed down through generations, now handcrafted in Hawaii. Ownership details and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces a line of Korean specialty foods including kim chee, wakame salad, seaweed salad, spicy pickled onion, jangachi, namasu, pickled onion, spicy takuwan, and takuwan. All items are handcrafted in small batches at their Maui facility. No facility size, headcount, or volume figures are disclosed.

Hawaii Commercial Foods serves the specialty food market, targeting retail, wholesale, and food-service customers seeking authentic Korean flavors. Its products are marketed directly through an online store and likely distributed to local Hawaiian retailers and restaurants.

The business was built around a heritage kim chee recipe originating from Busan, South Korea, emphasizing authenticity and traditional preparation methods. The company highlights its generational recipe and handcrafted approach as key differentiators.
